title: GH Mobile+
tabs.label: Tabs
banner.rateLimit: GitHub rate limit is low. Background refresh resumes {time}.
palette.title: Go to
palette.placeholder: owner/repo, owner/repo#123, @user, or a GitHub link
palette.empty: No matches. Try owner/repo, owner/repo#123, or @user.
palette.hint: Tip: press / on a hardware keyboard to open this from anywhere.
accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.signedOut: Signed out — tap to sign in again
accounts.limit: You can add up to {max} accounts. Sign out of one to add another.
accounts.signOutFailed: Couldn’t sign out. Check your connection and try again.
lock.title: GH Mobile+ is locked
lock.message: Unlock with Face ID, Touch ID, or your device passcode.
lock.signOutFailed: Couldn’t sign out. Check your connection and try again.
lock.privacyNote: App lock is a privacy screen, not a security boundary. It hides the app from people nearby, but it doesn’t encrypt your sign-in or saved data.
badge.denied: Notifications are turned off for this app, so the icon can’t show a count. Allow notifications in your device settings, then try again.
badge.unsupported: This browser can’t show a count on the app icon. Install the app to the Home Screen to use it.
signIn.publicOnlyHint: Asks GitHub for access to public repositories only. Private repositories won’t appear.
signIn.iosNote: The Home Screen app keeps its own sign-in, separate from Safari, so GitHub may ask you to sign in again.
signIn.error.stateMismatch: Sign-in couldn’t be verified, possibly because it started in another window. Please try again.
signIn.error.accessDenied: You canceled the GitHub authorization. Sign in again whenever you’re ready.
signIn.error.exchangeFailed: GitHub didn’t complete the sign-in. The code may have expired — please try again.
signIn.error.orgRestricted: An organization blocked this app. You can still sign in, then request approval from the organization.
signIn.error.accountLimit: You’ve reached the limit of {max} accounts. Sign out of one in Settings before adding another.
diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.s1Warning: Spike S1 marks one notification thread as read and done, and unsubscribes from it.
diagnostics.jobIdHint: Leave empty to use the latest completed job.
